description: This file contains a series of shell script tests for Git's diff-tree functionality, including creation of bogus trees, diff reporting, and patch application failure checks due to invalid SHA1 objects.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that is expected to succeed.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Defines a test case that is expected to fail.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output files.

methods.name: git hash-object
methods.description: Creates a blob object from stdin and writes it to the object database.

methods.name: git write-tree
methods.description: Creates a tree object from the current index.

methods.name: git rev-parse
methods.description: Resolves and outputs object IDs (SHA1) for references.

methods.name: git diff-tree
methods.description: Shows changes between two tree objects.

methods.name: git diff-index
methods.description: Shows changes between the working tree/index and a tree object.
